rule.expression: (http.host in {"www.ondorealestate.com" "ondorealestate.com"}) and not http.host in {"api.ondorealestate.com" "app.ondorealestate.com"} and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and any(lower(http.request.headers["accept"][*]) contains "text/markdown") and not http.request.uri.path matches "\\.(md|txt|xml|json|css|js|mjs|map|png|jpe?g|webp|svg|ico|woff2?)$"
rule.description: Serve sibling .md when Accept: text/markdown (agent readability)
